commit.message:
feat: configurable rounded blur region (blur_corner_radius) (#737)

Add a blur_corner_radius config option that controls the corner radius
of the ext-background-effect-v1 blur region.

Previously the blur region was a single rectangle (one wl_region rect),
which did not match themes with rounded .box-wrapper corners — the blur
bled past the rounded box. The region is now built from multiple small
wl_region rects approximating a rounded rectangle (1-px row steps with
rounded inset), so the blur follows the theme's box corner radius.

The region is cached and only rebuilt when size or radius changes.

Co-authored-by: djasdh <djasdh@users.noreply.github.com>

+### Niri workspace launch
+
+When Walker runs as a service, it can watch Niri's event stream and open automatically whenever an
+empty workspace receives focus:
+
+```toml
+[niri]
+launch_on_empty_workspace = true
+launch_on_startup = true
+cmd_on_esc = "niri msg action focus-workspace-previous"

+
+`launch_on_startup` opens Walker once when the initially focused workspace is empty. `cmd_on_esc`
+is optional and only runs when Escape closes Walker after an automatic launch.
+Automatic launches are deferred while Niri's overview is open and rechecked when it closes.
